results.name: [methyl-Co(III) methanol-specific corrinoid protein]:coenzyme M methyltransferase activity

definition.text: Catalysis of the reaction: a [methyl-Co(III) methanol-specific corrinoid protein] + coenzyme M = methyl-coenzyme M + a [Co(I) methanol-specific corrinoid protein] + H+.
Catalysis of the reaction: Co(I)-[trimethylamine-specific corrinoid protein] + H+ + trimethylamine = dimethylamine + methyl-Co(III)-[trimethylamine-specific corrinoid protein].
Catalysis of the reaction: dimethylamine + a dimethylamine corrinoid protein = a methylated dimethylamine corrinoid protein + methylamine.

results.name: [methyl-Co(III) methylamine-specific corrinoid protein]:coenzyme M methyltransferase activity

definition.text: Catalysis of the reaction: [methyl-Co(III) methylamine-specific corrinoid protein] + coenzyme M = [Co(I) methylamine-specific corrinoid protein] + H+ + methyl-coenzyme M. This reaction is the transfer of the methyl group from the methylated corrinoid cofactor of a methylamine corrinoid protein to coenzyme M.
